target conflicts stay NEEDS_DECISION until an explicit replace/keep; replace keeps a .pre-migration copy of the previous target
copies go through a .migrating file, fsync and SHA256 verification before an atomic rename; a failure keeps the original file and appends to the journal
downloads and logs are EXCLUDED_USER_FILES and stay exactly where they are; nothing is moved, deleted or replayed
doctor reports one state per capability and names the affected capabilities when Node or Chromium is missing
doctor release-layout blocks start-up when the program version and the bundled layout version disagree

limits: Linux was executed locally; the Windows result comes from GitHub Actions run 44053512576 on the same commit (Python 1305 passed / 13 skipped / 0 failed) and was not reproduced on a local Windows host. Real Windows DPAPI authentication is outside this module.
The wheel does not contain node_modules or the offline tests: after installing, run python scripts/dev.py setup-node (or npm ci --ignore-scripts).

Dependencies are pinned to exact direct versions with a license table; no transitive hash lock was generated because resolving every platform wheel needs network access, so artifact integrity comes from SHA256SUMS and the Node lock file.
Source archives are generated from Git objects, so uncommitted work never enters them and a dirty tracked tree must be committed or stashed before a build.
install-check uses a temporary --system-site-packages virtual environment to resolve runtime dependencies offline; it proves the layout and entry points, not real campus authentication.
Migration copies files only: it does not replay pending transactions, does not decrypt Windows DPAPI ciphertext on another platform and never deletes or moves the legacy tree.
The THU-TODOS-1 and THU-ACTION-1 outer containers are unchanged; record-level storage work remains with 6.1/8.1.
The module ownership table, batch gate and VERSION_MANIFEST were not edited to avoid conflicts with parallel 6.1/6.2 work; batch integration updates them.
No PR was opened, main was not merged, no tag or Release was created; release-manifest.json states candidate-not-released and published=false.
Byte-for-byte reproducibility was verified for two consecutive Linux builds of the same commit; cross-platform reproducibility is not claimed.
rollback: Restore the 6.3 files to bb1f963 (pyproject.toml, MANIFEST.in, requirements*.txt, setup.py, build_support/, the three scripts, version.py, upgrade.py, paths.py, gateway_client.py, gateway.js, docs and the two test files). The _bundled directory is additive: removing it returns resource resolution to the source layout. dist/ can be deleted wholesale. Migration never modified the legacy state directory, so no user directory has to be cleaned up; copied targets and .pre-migration backups stay for the user to keep or remove.
next: Batch 6 reconnects 6.1, 6.2 and 6.3 into one integration commit, runs scripts/dev.py check and test plus both-platform CI, then updates the ownership table, acceptance map, batch gate and VERSION_MANIFEST. No PR, merge, tag or release is opened by this module.
